content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I downloaded the installer for [product_name] Demo for school. After extracting the setup.zip with StuffIt Expander, I tried opening the setup.app but received the error message: "the app setup can't be opened." I have Mac OS Monterey 12.2.1 installed. Any help would be appreciated.
Check out this topic on upgrading [product_name] on Mac. [company_name] has not tested it with all Mac OS versions. The account "[product_name] Support" is an official account of [company_name].

I am experiencing the same issue. I downloaded the demo for [product_name] from [url], went to the MacOSX folder, and used StuffIt Expander to extract the "setup" application, but nothing happened. Then I attempted to unzip the setup application by double-clicking it, but got the error: "The application 'Setup' can’t be opened." My OS is Monterey 12.0.1. I have Java 8 update 321 installed. Can anyone assist?

Currently, [product_name] is only compatible with Mac OS X up to version 10.14. You can run [product_name] on the following operating systems: Windows (Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10); Linux (SUSE Linux 12 sp1, kernel 3.12.74, and other distributions compatible with Java 2); and Mac OS X: Lion (10.7), Mountain Lion (10.8), Mavericks (10.9), Yosemite (10.10), El Capitan (10.11), Sierra (10.12), High Sierra (10.13), and Mojave (10.14). Regards, [user_name] Support

I hope [company_name] will update [product_name] for Apple Silicon (planning to get one soon). It's possible to run the Windows version using Wine on Mac, although it's not an ideal solution. Mojave was released on September 24, 2018; I know my Mojave system uses jdk1.8.0_144.jdk.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that installing [product_name] Demo on MacOS Monterey results in a critical compatibility problem—the setup application will not open due to unsupported MacOS versions. An official support account from [company_name] confirmed that the current release works only with Mac OS X up to Mojave (10.14), meaning users on newer systems like Monterey cannot install or use the software natively. Workarounds such as running the Windows version via Wine on Mac are discussed in the forum, but are generally considered unsatisfactory.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] Demo to install and function smoothly on the latest MacOS versions, without encountering compatibility barriers or needing workaround solutions.
